title: Fooling set bound from a monochromatic rectangle partition
statement: Let $X$, $Y$, and $\alpha$ be sets and let $g : X \times Y \to \alpha$. If $S \subseteq X \times Y$ is a fooling set for $g$ and $\mathcal{P}$ is a monochromatic rectangle partition for $g$, then the cardinality of $S$ is at most the cardinality of $\mathcal{P}$, that is $\abs{S} \le \abs{\mathcal{P}}$, where cardinalities are compared as extended natural numbers (allowing the value $\infty$).
hypotheses_covered: S is a fooling set for g
Part is a monochromatic rectangle partition for g
